sugyot.title_en: if siur is a safek: if it is matza he fulfilled the matza vow, if chametz the chametz vow -- either way he fulfills
blemishes should disqualify Levites too, a fortiori from priests
the red heifer should be fit by breaking the neck too
a priest is fit until he ages, i.e. until he trembles
tokho-to-transmit / tokho-to-become-impure: just as the vessel transmits impurity through its airspace without contact, it becomes impure through its airspace without contact
'all work of goats' (Num 31:20) includes items that come from the goats -- from the horns and from the hooves
in a bird: if half is like a majority, the majority was already cut before the pause; if it is not, the half-cut was nothing and no tereifa arose -- either way the slaughter is valid
per Bei Rav's uncertainty about the hide: a knife concealed beneath a cloth on the neck -- what is the halakha?
do multiple pauses, each shorter than the measure, combine to disqualify the slaughter? (raised by Rava; left without any recorded verdict)

if where intent invalidates -- sacrificial animals -- everything follows only the performer of the rite, then where intent does not invalidate -- non-sacred animals -- surely everything follows only the slaughterer
one who slaughters an animal in order to sprinkle its blood or burn its fat for idol worship -- the slaughter is not valid (zivchei metim)
